title: White House reportedly approaches final framework for reviewing frontier models
summary: The US government is said to be close to creating a final version of a voluntary framework for evaluating AI companies' advanced models before they are released to the public. title: Intel Foundry completes US microelectronics prototype program

title: Analysis: What Seagate's blowout quarter signals about the next two years of AI infrastructure demand
